name: Hky_gameInstance
note: Hky_createGame; deleted by RPHkyGame::Exit; HUD layouts read the message, timer, state and paddles through it

name: Hky_lightPos
note: (0, 745, 0), Hky_sinitLightPos; copied into light 0 by RPHkyGame::Create

name: Hky_cpuStallPuckPos
note: function static of RPHkyPaddle::UpdateCpuStallTimer: puck position last frame

name: Hky_cpuStallCounter
note: frames the puck sat still on the CPU side; after 40 the CPU gets mCpuStallTimer = 20

name: Hky_debugHoldPuck
note: when non-zero RPHkyPuck::ApplyVelocity pins the puck at (Hky_debugHoldPuckX, 0, Hky_debugHoldPuckZ); never set

name: Hky_puckRadius
note: 16; collision radius for the wall/paddle tests

name: Hky_puckSpeed
note: current puck speed factor; reset to Hky_puckSpeedInit, raised by Hky_puckSpeedStep per goal up to Hky_puckSpeedMax

name: Hky_puckSpeedInit
note: 0.6 in the file; RPHkyPuck::Create sets 0.65 (widescreen) or 0.5

name: Hky_puckWallBounce
note: 1.0; (1 + e) factor of the wall reflection

name: Hky_puckPaddleBounce
note: 1.0; (1 + e) factor of the paddle reflection

name: Hky_puckSpinImpulseScale
note: -10; scales the cross product giving mSpinImpulse

name: Hky_puckGravity
note: -0.003; added to velocity Y per sub-step

name: Hky_puckGoalDepth
note: -10; puck Y below this counts as fallen into the goal

name: Hky_puckHitCooldown
note: 9 frames between hits from the same paddle/wall

name: Hky_fieldLength
note: 880 in the file; RPHkyGame::Create sets 1000 (widescreen) or 800

name: Hky_fieldWidth
note: 440 in the file; RPHkyGame::Create sets 500 (widescreen) or 400

name: Hky_cpuSkill
note: 0.3 in the file; adapted between Hky_cpuSkillMin and Hky_cpuSkillMax as goals are scored

name: Hky_PuckTrail_vtable
note: puck sound actor (derived from the shared sound actor, vtable 80358964)

name: Hky_SceneSound_vtable
note: scene sound object (derived from the shared scene sound base, vtable 803587D0)
